IFCAT-005.previous_note: Native confirmation defaults and modal precedence have tests. Remove-destination confirmation defaulted to Yes for a destructive keyring delete; it now defaults to No. Every one of the 20 choice confirmations in app/ (QMessageBox) is source-checked for an explicit safe default (Cancel/No/Save) and a non-generic title, the remove confirmation names the destination and the keyring deletion, and six real dialogs (QR code, colour picker, hash checker, icon converter, new image, open from URL) are driven modal: the modal trap exists only while open, the title identifies the purpose, a Cancel/Close action exists, no default button is destructive, Escape rejects, and focus returns to the host control. Remaining: the other ~30 modal dialog classes (editor, capture, workflow, history, settings, file pickers) are only covered by the source scan, not driven for focus restore; permission prompts are portal-owned and unreviewed. Audit 2026-11-03: ModalDialogsTest::everyChoiceConfirmationDefaultsToASafeButtonAndHasAPurposefulTitle (fails on the old implicit-Yes default), removingADestinationSaysWhatIsDeletedDefaultsToNoAndRestoresFocus and modalDialogsTrapFocusOnlyWhileActiveIdentifyPurposeEscapeAndRestoreFocus (6 dialogs). Not enough to classify every modal dialog, so the row stays partial. Rationale: default-Cancel/No for destructive confirmations is the Qt/GNOME HIG and reference ShareX behavior. Update 2026-11-04: ModalDialogsTest now also drives Insert Image, Scan QR codes, Recognize text (OCR) and Compare Images through the modal trap/purpose/Escape/safe-default/focus-restore checks (ten dialogs driven in total).

IFCAT-009.previous_note: Non-interactive refusal is generic: any graphical operation (every capture source, edit, run-workflow, all recording commands and a plain launch) returns presentation-required (exit 1, fixed actionable text, requestId only) before QApplication, display, instance election, preferences or portal consent, and never forwards to a running instance. Read-only list/result commands never prompt. No current CLI command takes credentials or destructive approval, so those cases cannot arise until such commands exist. Audit 2026-11-03: each operation refused with presentation-required and no side effects: NativeInstanceTest::workflowCliRefusesMalformedHeadlessAndMissingProfilesWithoutSideEffects (rows run-workflow, capture-region, capture-full-screen, capture-monitor, capture-active-window, start-recording, stop-recording, region-recording-headless, edit, plain-launch; checks stable code, actionable stderr 'No operation was started.', no leaked argument, no display/profile/instance access); not forwarded to a live owner: NativeInstanceTest::nonInteractiveNeverForwardsToARunningOwnerOrPerformsTheOperation (all eight actions plus plain launch). Rationale: refusal over prompting matches ShareX/Flameshot headless behavior.

IFCAT-015.previous_note: Supported native providers are versioned custom HTTP destinations. Shared configuration retains scoped keyring references; SecretServiceCredentialStore owns credentials. Ordinary catalog viewing/validation is local. The destinations UI now offers explicit Test connection and Cancel test: owned preparation resolves only the selected destination ID scope, and a content-free HEAD probe disables redirects, cookie load/save and authentication reuse. Filename-dependent endpoints are refused; success explicitly means HEAD reachability, not upload authorization. Escape/Close/cancel and owner destruction retire pending work or abort the reply, with timeout and value-free stable diagnostics. DestinationConnectionTestTest uses an injected counting network manager to prove zero requests on load/view/validation, click-only HEAD with no body, scoped credentials, invalid endpoint/refusal, success/HTTP/network/redirect/unsupported failures, cancellation before preparation and during transfer, timeout, owner teardown and redaction. No OAuth provider/authorization flow is currently supported. Rationale: reference CustomUploaderEditorViewModel.TestUploaderAsync is preview-only; the requested explicit HEAD probe supplies connection reachability without publishing sample/capture content. Human credential/security review remains Required before release. Final consent review found that viewing previously used an interactive secret lookup. Viewing now calls metadata-only availability (SearchItems, no session, Unlock, Prompt or GetSecrets), and connection preparation uses lookupWithoutPrompt so a locked keyring fails without leaving an authorization prompt. The injected credential counter proves viewing performs zero secret reads and the probe uses only non-prompting scoped reads. SecretServiceCredentialStoreTest::availabilityAndProbeReadsNeverUnlockOrPrompt adds real transport evidence, but its private D-Bus test must pass outside the sandbox before promoting these security-sensitive rows. Keep partial pending that evidence and credential/security review.
